text: In 2023-02 we converged on one occasion. Sixty-seven of us said "state of the union"; sixty-six of us said "state of the union address"; both peaked on 2023-02-07, the day it was delivered. Thirty-three of us marked it "biden's state of the union," thirty-two "biden's state of the union address," twenty-seven "president biden's state of the union"—the same event, attributed, narrowing as it specified. Nineteen of us kept "the state of the union." First-sayer of the plain phrase, in our record, was John Barrasso; of the possessive framing, Mariannette Miller-Meeks. Away from that night, eighteen of us referenced "the 118th congress" on 2023-02-01, and sixteen of us issued a "statement in response to" on 2023-02-07. What the record shows of this era is a single evening, said many ways, by many of us at once.
